name: IPGeolocation.io IP enrichment
summary: Security and location enrichment of source_ip from the IPGeolocation.io API.
description:
Enriches the `source_ip` field of your messages with IPGeolocation.io data, using two
independent pipelines. Connect either or both to the streams you want enriched.

- **IPGeolocation.io Security** (paid plans): threat score, VPN, proxy, residential proxy (with last-seen
  dates and 7/30-day activity), Tor, relay, bot, spam, known attacker, cloud provider and corporate gateway
  signals, as `source_ip_ipgeolocation_*` fields.
- **IPGeolocation.io Location**: country, region, city, coordinates, time zone and ASN in Graylog's standard
  `source_geo_*` and `source_as_*` fields, the same fields Graylog's GeoIP processor writes.

Private and reserved addresses are skipped. Each IP is looked up once per 24 hours (up to 100,000 IPs per
node). The API key is sent in the `X-IPGeolocation-API-Key` header and is entered when you install the pack.

parameters.name: IPGEOLOCATION_API_KEY
parameters.title: IPGeolocation.io API key
parameters.description: Your API key from https://app.ipgeolocation.io/ (sent in the X-IPGeolocation-API-Key header).

description.@value: 24 h per IP, up to 100,000 IPs per Graylog node.
IP location from IPGeolocation.io (/v3/ipgeo): country, region, city, coordinates, time zone and ASN.

source.@value:
rule "IPGeolocation.io location: source_ip"
when
  has_field("source_ip") &&
  is_ip(value: to_string($message.source_ip), attemptConversion: true) &&
  ! cidr_match("0.0.0.0/8", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("10.0.0.0/8", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("100.64.0.0/10", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("127.0.0.0/8", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("169.254.0.0/16", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("172.16.0.0/12", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("192.0.0.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("192.0.2.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("192.88.99.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("192.168.0.0/16", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("198.18.0.0/15", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("198.51.100.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("203.0.113.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("224.0.0.0/4", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("233.252.0.0/24", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("240.0.0.0/4", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("255.255.255.255/32", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("::/128", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("::1/128", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("100::/64", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("2001:db8::/32", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("fc00::/7", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("fe80::/10", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  ! cidr_match("ff00::/8", to_ip($message.source_ip)) &&
  lookup_has_value("ipgeolocation-location", to_string($message.source_ip))
then
  let r = lookup("ipgeolocation-location", to_string($message.source_ip));
  set_field("source_geo_coordinates", concat(concat(to_string(r.location.latitude), ","), to_string(r.location.longitude)));
  set_field("source_geo_country_iso", r.location.country_code2);
  set_field("source_geo_country", r.location.country_name);
  set_field("source_geo_region", r.location.state_prov);
  set_field("source_geo_city", r.location.city);
  set_field("source_geo_timezone", r.time_zone.name);
  set_field("source_as_number", replace(to_string(r.asn.as_number), "AS", ""));
  set_field("source_as_organization", r.asn.organization);
end
